shared_elements: carved stone surface worked in low relief
curved incised outlines forming symmetrical paired shapes
figural or quasi-figural forms above a lower band
justification: Both are grey stone surfaces bearing relief carving in which a prominent circular disc appears roughly at mid-height amid paired symmetrical curved forms, and both place denser motifs in the upper zone above a plainer lower band. Beyond that the resemblance collapses: B is a crisply modelled, naturalistic profile scene of two clothed standing figures rendered by a highly controlled hand, while A is a heavily eroded, three-dimensional block whose carvings are schematic, shallow, non-narrative and irregularly distributed over a curved surface.
